entity: Motor Vehicle Manufacturers Association of the United States, Inc.
summary: The Motor Vehicle Manufacturers Association of the United States endorses the intent of Executive Order No. 11644 and the proposed regulations implementing it. However, MVMA objects to the proposed broad definition of 'off-road vehicles' that would encompass standard automobiles capable of off-road use, arguing it is meaningless and could inadvertently restrict conventional highway vehicles on roads. They urge that regulations focus on the off-road use of vehicles rather than adopting an overly broad definitional framework.
